title: Lazy lists
note: Infinite lists are ordinary values. The program computes only the part that it prints.

title: GADTs
note: AIHC accepts the extensions of GHC. Here the type of an expression says what it evaluates to.

title: Green threads
note: The runtime schedules lightweight threads across cores. An MVar carries results and guards shared state.

title: Unboxed types
note: AIHC follows GHC down to the machine: unboxed sums, unlifted data, and code that is polymorphic in the runtime representation. GHC 9.12 prints the same output.

title: Generics
note: One generic function encodes every record as JSON. This is the mechanism that libraries such as aeson use, and AIHC derives the representation as GHC does.

title: Mandelbrot
note: A tight loop over machine doubles. Edit the size or the limit and run it again: the compiler and the program both run in your browser.
